import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Insights - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(top_breeds))
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
# Filter valid ages
valid_ages = [col for col in age_counts.index if 'Jährige' in str(col)]
age_data = age_counts[valid_ages]
# Extract numeric part for sorting
age_numeric = {age: int(age.split('-')[0]) for age in age_data.index}
age_data_sorted = age_data.reindex(sorted(age_data.index, key=lambda x: age_numeric[x]))
colors_age = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_data_sorted))
age_data_sorted.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=colors_age, width=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('husl', len(district_counts))
district_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=colors_district, width=0.75)
ax3.set_xlabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution Across Zurich Districts', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Dog Gender vs Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'], normalize='index') * 100
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=10)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0, labelsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 100)
# Add percentage labels on bars
for container in ax4.containers:
    ax4.bar_label(container, fmt='%.1f%%', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
